character.description: the same recurring anime protagonist in the pirate sea chart world, with consistent face, hairstyle, outfit silhouette, age impression, and body proportions throughout the entire music video
consistency_rules: keep the same face and hairstyle across scenes
keep outfit design and color identity consistent unless the story explicitly changes them
keep age impression, body proportions, and character identity stable
do not introduce additional protagonists unless the lyrics or scene require them

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in galleon on open water, sandy island cove with chests, storm-tossed sea; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with ocean teal, parchment tan, timber brown, treasure gold; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by low deck-level shot of billowing sails, wide aerial view of a galleon at sea, close-up of a compass and worn map; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
